signals.summary: Acme Fintech raised $40 million in a Series C round led by Lightspeed.
signals.evidence: Bengaluru-based Acme Fintech has raised $40 million in a Series C round led by Lightspeed, with participation from existing investors Sequoia and Accel.

signals.summary: Acme Fintech plans to expand into Southeast Asia over the next 12 months.
signals.evidence: The company said it will use the funds to double its engineering team and expand into Southeast Asia over the next 12 months.
